transition_rules.observed_to_developing: two positive evidence events or successful guided construction
transition_rules.developing_to_provisional_mastery: minimum 5/6 mastery slots correct, including direct and novel transfer, with at least 4 independent
transition_rules.provisional_to_reliable_mastery: pass one delayed retention check and no critical misconception in latest two attempts
transition_rules.any_to_fragile: previous mastery followed by failed delayed or novel-format check
transition_rules.any_to_needs_remediation: critical misconception repeated in two distinct representations

next_action_rules.when: two consecutive incorrect attempts with same representation
three consecutive incorrect attempts or random clicking
correct with high confidence and independent

placement_rules.placement_band_rule: highest grade with >=0.70 overall and no diagnostic-critical domain below 0.50
placement_rules.learning_start_rule: lowest diagnostic-critical prerequisite below 0.60 on the path to the learner's current goal
placement_rules.learner_facing_label: recommended starting band, never a fixed identity label
